scripts.process:photos:setup: cd photos/process_photos && rm -rf .venv && python3.11 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r ./requirements.txt && echo '✅ Setup complete! venv recreated with Python 3.11 and dependencies installed.' && cd ../..
scripts.process:photos: cd photos && . process_photos/.venv/bin/activate && python3 -m process_photos && deactivate && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SASS,TS,PHP,LOAD -c magenta,yellow,blue,green, "npm run dev:sass-watch" "npm run dev:ts-watch" "npm run dev:php-server" "npm run dev:load-tab"
scripts.test:py: cd photos && . process_photos/.venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. pytest process_photos/tests
scripts.document: npm run document:sass && npm run document:ts && npm run document:php
scripts.deploy:stage:code: ssh goat "cd ~/dev.geekofalltrades.org && git pull origin main"
scripts.deploy:stage:code:safe: npm test && npm run deploy:stage:health:local && npm run deploy:stage:health && npm run deploy:stage:snapshot && npm run deploy:stage:code && npm run deploy:stage:health && npm run deploy:stage:tidy && echo 'Stage deploy OK' || (echo 'Stage deploy FAILED — rolling back' && npm run deploy:stage:rollback)
scripts.deploy:stage: npm run deploy:stage:code && npm run deploy:stage:photos
scripts.deploy:prod:update: npm run deploy:prod:update:structure && npm run deploy:prod:update:content
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:prod:health && npm run deploy:prod:snapshot && npm run deploy:prod:update && npm run deploy:prod:health && npm run deploy:prod:tidy && echo 'Deploy OK' || (echo 'Deploy FAILED — rolling back' && npm run deploy:prod:rollback)
